api_scoring_contract.default: For ordinary testcase-backed QA, score expected_api normally.
api_scoring_contract.CT_28: Do not score hidden prd_id=20260907 as an LTM/rewrite requirement. Score semantic fields only; fixture_expected_api is reserved for downstream KiRa fixture replay.
api_scoring_contract.CT_79: Relative-time semantics are explicit in the question and temporal_fixture; expected_api can be scored with that fixture.

required_metrics.name: micro_accuracy
required_metrics.definition: Total correct QA / total evaluated QA.

required_metrics.name: macro_scenario_accuracy
required_metrics.definition: Compute accuracy within each scenario_group, then average equally across scenario groups.

score_reporting_contract.reporting_note: Do not rely on QA-row micro accuracy alone because some scenario groups contain more paraphrases than others.

headline_scope.hard_gate_micro: Compute micro accuracy only over hard_gate=true QA.
headline_scope.hard_gate_macro_scenario: Compute scenario-group macro accuracy using only hard_gate=true QA.
headline_scope.diagnostic_history: Report separately; do not mix into baseline headline accuracy and do not fail the active-memory baseline on diagnostic_history cases.

retrieval_scoring_global_contract.policy_overlap_no_hit_rule: If a QA has supporting relevant memory, it is excluded from the no-hit FPR bucket. Precision-relevant memories are strict_required_memory_ids ∪ supporting_memory_ids.
